booking.name: claim_booking_result_outbox_delivery
booking.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_booking_result_outbox_delivery(p_operation_id text, p_delivery_token uuid, p_lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 60)
 RETURNS SETOF booking_result_outbox
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  update public.booking_result_outbox
  set status = 'delivering',
      attempts = attempts + 1,
      delivery_token = p_delivery_token,
      lease_expires_at = now() + make_interval(secs => greatest(10, least(p_lease_seconds, 300))),
      updated_at = now(),
      last_error = null
  where operation_id = btrim(p_operation_id)
    and (
      status in ('pending', 'failed') or
      (status = 'delivering' and lease_expires_at <= now())
    )
  returning *;
$function$

booking.name: claim_booking_slot_reservation
booking.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_booking_slot_reservation(p_business_id bigint, p_calendar_identity text, p_start_time timestamp with time zone, p_end_time timestamp with time zone, p_operation_id text, p_customer_key text, p_expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS SETOF booking_slot_reservations
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_end_time <= p_start_time or p_expires_at <= now() then
    raise exception 'invalid slot reservation interval';
  end if;

  return query
  insert into public.booking_slot_reservations as reservation (
    business_id, calendar_identity, start_time, end_time,
    operation_id, customer_key, status, expires_at
  ) values (
    p_business_id, btrim(p_calendar_identity), p_start_time, p_end_time,
    btrim(p_operation_id), btrim(p_customer_key), 'reserved', p_expires_at
  )
  on conflict (business_id, calendar_identity, start_time, end_time)
  do update set
    operation_id = excluded.operation_id,
    customer_key = excluded.customer_key,
    status = 'reserved',
    expires_at = excluded.expires_at,
    updated_at = now()
  where
    reservation.status = 'released' or
    (
      reservation.status = 'reserved' and
      (
        reservation.operation_id = excluded.operation_id or
        reservation.expires_at <= now()
      )
    )
  returning reservation.*;
end;
$function$

booking.name: complete_booking_result_outbox_delivery
booking.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_booking_result_outbox_delivery(p_operation_id text, p_delivery_token uuid, p_delivered boolean, p_error text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare changed integer;
begin
  update public.booking_result_outbox
  set status = case when p_delivered then 'delivered' else 'failed' end,
      delivered_at = case when p_delivered then now() else delivered_at end,
      lease_expires_at = null,
      last_error = case when p_delivered then null else left(coalesce(p_error, 'delivery_failed'), 500) end,
      updated_at = now()
  where operation_id = btrim(p_operation_id)
    and delivery_token = p_delivery_token
    and status = 'delivering';
  get diagnostics changed = row_count;
  if changed = 1 then
    return true;
  end if;

  -- A provider acknowledgement may be retried after the process loses its
  -- response. Return the existing terminal success only to the same lease
  -- token; foreign tokens must not be able to acknowledge this delivery.
  return p_delivered and exists (
    select 1
    from public.booking_result_outbox
    where operation_id = btrim(p_operation_id)
      and delivery_token = p_delivery_token
      and status = 'delivered'
  );
end;
$function$

release_booking_slot_reservation
booking.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.release_booking_slot_reservation(p_business_id bigint, p_calendar_identity text, p_start_time timestamp with time zone, p_end_time timestamp with time zone, p_operation_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare changed integer;
begin
  update public.booking_slot_reservations
  set status = 'released', expires_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  where business_id = p_business_id
    and calendar_identity = btrim(p_calendar_identity)
    and start_time = p_start_time
    and end_time = p_end_time
    and operation_id = btrim(p_operation_id)
    and status = 'reserved';
  get diagnostics changed = row_count;
  return changed = 1;
end;
$function$

booking.name: settle_booking_slot_reservation
booking.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.settle_booking_slot_reservation(p_business_id bigint, p_calendar_identity text, p_start_time timestamp with time zone, p_end_time timestamp with time zone, p_operation_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare changed integer;
begin
  update public.booking_slot_reservations
  set status = 'settled', expires_at = 'infinity'::timestamptz, updated_at = now()
  where business_id = p_business_id
    and calendar_identity = btrim(p_calendar_identity)
    and start_time = p_start_time
    and end_time = p_end_time
    and operation_id = btrim(p_operation_id)
    and status in ('reserved', 'settled');
  get diagnostics changed = row_count;
  return changed = 1;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.odin_guard_knowledge_ingress_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if old.knowledge_turn_id is not null and row(new.business_id,new.conversation_id,new.channel,new.provider_scope,new.provider_event_id,
    new.knowledge_turn_id,new.knowledge_sequence,new.knowledge_accepted_at,new.knowledge_expires_at,new.knowledge_max_runs,new.knowledge_max_models)
    is distinct from row(old.business_id,old.conversation_id,old.channel,old.provider_scope,old.provider_event_id,
    old.knowledge_turn_id,old.knowledge_sequence,old.knowledge_accepted_at,old.knowledge_expires_at,old.knowledge_max_runs,old.knowledge_max_models)
  then raise exception 'knowledge_immutable_ingress'; end if;
  return new;
end $function$

constraints.name: businesses_ai_tone_config_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK (((jsonb_typeof(ai_tone_config) = 'object'::text) AND (ai_tone_config ?& ARRAY['tonePreset'::text, 'responseLength'::text, 'emojiUsage'::text, 'formality'::text, 'customToneInstructions'::text]) AND (jsonb_typeof((ai_tone_config -> 'tonePreset'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((ai_tone_config ->> 'tonePreset'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['professional'::text, 'friendly'::text, 'warm'::text, 'casual'::text, 'concise'::text, 'custom'::text])) AND (jsonb_typeof((ai_tone_config -> 'responseLength'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((ai_tone_config ->> 'responseLength'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['short'::text, 'balanced'::text, 'detailed'::text])) AND (jsonb_typeof((ai_tone_config -> 'emojiUsage'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((ai_tone_config ->> 'emojiUsage'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['none'::text, 'light'::text, 'expressive'::text])) AND (jsonb_typeof((ai_tone_config -> 'formality'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((ai_tone_config ->> 'formality'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['formal'::text, 'balanced'::text, 'casual'::text])) AND (jsonb_typeof((ai_tone_config -> 'customToneInstructions'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (length((ai_tone_config ->> 'customToneInstructions'::text)) <= 500)))

constraints.definition: CHECK (((knowledge_turn_id IS NULL) OR COALESCE(((task_type = 'knowledge_async_v1'::text) AND (knowledge_inbox_id IS NOT NULL) AND (knowledge_channel = ANY (ARRAY['whatsapp'::text, 'telegram'::text, 'instagram'::text, 'messenger'::text])) AND (knowledge_account ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9:_-]{1,160}$'::text) AND (knowledge_sequence > 0) AND (knowledge_expires_at > knowledge_accepted_at) AND (knowledge_expires_at <= (knowledge_accepted_at + '00:02:00'::interval)) AND (knowledge_state = ANY (ARRAY['ACCEPTED'::text, 'RUNNING'::text, 'VERIFIED'::text, 'FINALIZED'::text, 'FAILED'::text, 'EXPIRED'::text, 'SUPERSEDED'::text])) AND ((knowledge_max_runs >= 1) AND (knowledge_max_runs <= 5)) AND ((knowledge_max_models >= 1) AND (knowledge_max_models <= 8)) AND ((knowledge_run_attempts >= 0) AND (knowledge_run_attempts <= knowledge_max_runs)) AND ((knowledge_model_attempts >= 0) AND (knowledge_model_attempts <= knowledge_max_models))), false)))
